## Skills

A skill costs its one-line `description` in every session; the body loads only on invocation.
After compaction an invoked body is re-injected but truncated to 5,000 tokens, keeping the start of the file.

### Skill totals

| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Skills | 26 |
| Total body bytes (loaded only when invoked) | 281521 |
| Startup listing cost (descriptions only) | 3114 |
| Skills estimated over the 5,000-token cap on both ratios | 7 |
| Skills over on the dense ratio only | 1 |

**These counts are estimates, not observations.** The bytes-per-token ratio was
calibrated against `/context` output for *memory files*; no per-skill tokenization was
measured. A skill near the boundary could fall on either side. To turn these into
observations, invoke each skill and read its reported token count from `/context`.
Do not restate these numbers downstream as confirmed cap violations.

## Always-loaded budget

Components are kept separate rather than summed into one figure, because they are not
interchangeable and only some are comparable with the #108 baseline.

| Component | Bytes | Comparable with #108 baseline |
|---|---:|---|
| `global/CLAUDE.md` | 16137 | yes |
| `@`-referenced rules (`include`) | 47482 | yes |
| Bare rule files (`session_start`) | 7477 | no — #108 drove this to zero |
| Skill descriptions, this repo only | 3114 | no — not in the baseline |

### Comparison with the #108 post-fix baseline

The baseline covered `global/CLAUDE.md` plus its `@`-referenced rules and nothing else,
so only those two rows may be compared against it.

| | Bytes |
|---|---:|
| #108 post-fix baseline | 56994 |
| Same components measured now | 63619 |
| Drift | 6625 |

**This is a repository-only lower bound, not the true always-loaded total.**
At least one always-loaded `@`-import lives outside this repository and cannot be
measured by a sweep of `rules/`; see `claude-config-load-findings.md`. Any budget set
from these numbers must be set against observed load rather than against this table.
